description: This Go source file implements a serverless agent using the Agent-Field SDK. It sets up configuration from environment variables, registers two reasoning handlers ('hello' and 'relay'), and starts an HTTP server to handle requests.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that configures the agent, registers reasoners, and starts the HTTP server.

methods.name: envOr
methods.description: Retrieves environment variable by name or returns a fallback value if unset or empty.

methods.name: srvAddress
methods.description: Determines the server address string based on the listen setting.

methods.name: defaultString
methods.description: Returns the value if non-empty after trimming, otherwise returns the fallback.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Converts various types to string, primarily string and byte slices.
